title: BREAKING: Laredo Police Arrest Juan Elizondo on Criminal Mischief Charge
excerpt: BREAKING: Laredo police arrested Juan Elizondo early Tuesday on a criminal mischief charge (property damage of $100 to under $750, a Class B misdemeanor). Bond was set at $1,000 in case #PFCC26-003308L1. An arrest is an allegation; the accused is presumed innocent.
content:
BREAKING — Laredo police arrested Juan Elizondo early Tuesday, October 20, 2026, on a criminal mischief charge, according to Webb County booking records.

Elizondo was arrested at 5:29 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail (Booking #202608890) on one count of criminal mischief — damage or destruction of property valued at $100 or more but less than $750 — a Class B misdemeanor under Texas law. Bond was set at $1,000, cash or bail surety, in case #PFCC26-003308L1. Court records also list him under the name Juan Gabriel Elizondo, and he was taken before a magistrate at 10:25 a.m. on Tuesday.

Criminal mischief covers intentionally or knowingly damaging another person's property, and the class of the charge rises with the dollar value of the loss. A Class B misdemeanor in Texas is punishable by up to 180 days in jail and a fine of up to $2,000. The records reviewed by Webb Watch 956 do not describe what property was allegedly damaged or where the alleged offense happened.

Webb Watch 956 will follow case #PFCC26-003308L1 as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Juan Elizondo is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Booking #202608890, Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal (Case #PFCC26-003308L1).

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
